Tamanho da oscilação — no som, a amplitu: The size of the oscillation; in sound, the amplitude of the pressure variation. It's related (nonlinearly) to the sensation of loudness.
Posição dentro do ciclo de uma onda em u: Position within a wave's cycle at a given instant, measured in degrees or radians. Phase differences determine how waves add or cancel.
Unidade logarítmica que expressa a razão: A logarithmic unit expressing the ratio between two quantities. For amplitude quantities (pressure, voltage): 20·log₁₀(ratio); for power: 10·log₁₀(ratio).
Nível de pressão sonora: pressão em deci: Sound pressure level: pressure in decibels relative to 20 µPa, approximately the threshold of hearing at 1 kHz.
Decibéis relativos ao fundo de escala di: Decibels relative to digital full scale: 0 dBFS is the largest representable value. Digital signals have negative levels in dBFS.
Nível de tensão em decibéis relativo a 1: Voltage level in decibels relative to 1 V RMS.
Nível de tensão em decibéis relativo a 0: Voltage level in decibels relative to 0.775 V RMS (the voltage that dissipates 1 mW in 600 Ω). Professional audio standard: +4 dBu ≈ 1.23 V.
Valor quadrático médio (root mean square: Root mean square: the "effective average" of an alternating signal, which determines the power it delivers. For a sine wave, RMS = peak/√2.
Componente de frequência que é múltiplo: A frequency component that's an integer multiple of the fundamental. A periodic 200 Hz sound can contain 400, 600, 800 Hz…
A menor frequência de uma série harmônic: The lowest frequency of a harmonic series; it normally defines the perceived pitch of the note.
Qualidade que distingue dois sons de mes: The quality that distinguishes two sounds of the same pitch and loudness. It depends on the spectrum, the evolution over time (attack, decay) and characteristic noises.
Representação de um sinal como soma de c: A representation of a signal as a sum of components at different frequencies, with their amplitudes (and phases).
Transformada rápida de Fourier: algoritm: Fast Fourier transform: an algorithm that efficiently calculates the spectrum of a block of digital samples.
Região de ressonância do trato vocal (ou: A resonant region of the vocal tract (or an instrument) that boosts nearby harmonics. Formants define vowels.
Intervalo entre duas frequências na razã: The interval between two frequencies in a 2:1 ratio. Hearing perceives frequencies roughly logarithmically: each octave "takes up the same space."
Órgão em espiral do ouvido interno que d: Spiral organ of the inner ear that breaks sound into frequencies along the basilar membrane and turns it into nerve impulses.
Estrutura dentro da cóclea cuja rigidez: A structure inside the cochlea whose stiffness varies along its length; each position vibrates most for a band of frequencies (tonotopy).
Receptores sensoriais da cóclea. As inte: Sensory receptors of the cochlea. Inner ones transduce movement into nerve signals; outer ones actively amplify faint vibrations.
Unidade de nível de sonoridade: um som t: Unit of loudness level: a sound has N phons if it sounds as loud as a 1 kHz tone at N dB SPL.
Unidade de sonoridade em escala linear d: Unit of loudness on a linear perceptual scale: 2 sones sound twice as loud as 1 sone (about +10 phons).
Norma que define as curvas de igual sono: Standard that defines equal-loudness contours for pure tones in a free field, for otologically normal listeners aged 18 to 25.
Redução da audibilidade de um som pela p: The reduced audibility of one sound due to the presence of another. It's strongest between nearby frequencies and spreads further upward than downward.
Largura de um “filtro auditivo”: sons de: The width of an "auditory filter": sounds in the same critical band interact strongly (they mask each other and add loudness). Measured in ERB or Bark.
Largura de banda retangular equivalente: Equivalent rectangular bandwidth of an auditory filter. By the Glasberg & Moore formula: ERB = 24.7·(4.37·f/1000 + 1) Hz.
Diferença interaural de tempo: atraso en: Interaural time difference: the delay between sound reaching one ear and the other (up to ~0.7 ms). The main localization cue at low frequencies.
Diferença interaural de nível: o ouvido: Interaural level difference: the farther ear receives less energy because of the head's shadow. The dominant cue above ~1.5 kHz.
Função de transferência relativa à cabeç: Head-related transfer function: how the head, torso and ears modify a sound coming from a given direction on its way to the eardrum. It's individual.
A orelha externa visível. Suas dobras e: The visible outer ear. Its folds and cavities create resonances and cancellations that depend on the direction of the sound.
Cavidade principal da orelha, que leva à: The main cavity of the outer ear, leading to the entrance of the ear canal. It generates a resonance near 5 kHz.
O ganho acústico, com pico entre ~2 e 5: The acoustic gain, peaking between ~2 and 5 kHz, that the pinna, concha and ear canal produce between the sound field and the eardrum.
Ponto de referência do tímpano (drum ref: Drum reference point: the location where sound pressure "at the eardrum" is defined in standards such as ISO 11904.
Condição acústica sem reflexões, com o s: An acoustic condition with no reflections, with sound arriving from a single direction (normally from the front).
Condição em que o som chega com igual en: A condition in which sound arrives with equal energy from all directions. The diffuse-field response at the eardrum is a classic reference for headphones.
Como um sistema altera o nível (e a fase: How a system changes the level (and phase) of each frequency. In headphones, it's measured as sound pressure on a coupler as a function of frequency.
Resposta em frequência de referência que: A reference frequency response considered ideal (by some criterion) for a headphone measured on a given rig.
Família de curvas-alvo derivadas de test: A family of target curves derived from preference tests carried out at Harman International by Sean Olive and colleagues (2012–2019).
Elevação em “degrau” dos graves abaixo d: A "stepped" rise in the bass below a certain frequency (typically ~100–200 Hz), as opposed to a narrow peak.
Exagero dos sons de “s”, “ch” e “z”, con: Exaggeration of "s," "sh" and "z" sounds, concentrated at ~5–10 kHz, usually caused by peaks in that region (or present in the recording).
Descrição resumida do equilíbrio tonal d: A short description of a headphone's tonal balance (neutral, warm, bright, V-shaped…) relative to a reference.
Simulador de ouvido ocluído padronizado: A standardized occluded-ear simulator that reproduces the average acoustic impedance of the ear canal and eardrum. The basis of most IEM measurements.
Simulador de cabeça e tronco da Brüel &: A Brüel & Kjær head and torso simulator with an anatomical ear canal and more realistic eardrum impedance, valid to higher frequencies than the 711.
Head and Torso Simulator: manequim acúst: Head and Torso Simulator: an acoustic mannequin with head, ears and torso used to measure headphones and HRTFs.
Média da curva em janelas de fração de o: Averaging a curve over windows of a fraction of an octave (1/3, 1/12, 1/24…). It hides narrow details and should be stated when comparing graphs.
O transdutor que converte o sinal elétri: The transducer that converts the electrical signal into air movement inside a headphone.
Transdutor com bobina móvel presa a um d: A transducer with a moving coil attached to a diaphragm, in the field of a magnet. The Lorentz force moves the assembly.
Transdutor em que uma palheta magnética: A transducer in which a magnetic reed (armature) balanced between magnets vibrates and moves a diaphragm via a pin. Compact and efficient.
Transdutor com um condutor plano deposit: A transducer with a flat conductor on a thin membrane placed between magnets; the force is distributed over the whole surface.
Transdutor em que uma membrana carregada: A transducer in which a charged membrane is moved by electrostatic forces between perforated plates. It requires high voltages (or a step-up transformer).
Rede de filtros (elétricos e/ou acústico: A network of filters (electrical and/or acoustic) that divides the spectrum among specialized drivers.
Cavidade conectada ao exterior por um ga: A cavity connected to the outside by a neck; the mass of air in the neck oscillates against the "spring" of air in the cavity, with a well-defined resonance.
Elemento resistivo (malha, tecido, espum: A resistive element (mesh, fabric, foam) that dissipates acoustic energy, attenuating resonance peaks.
Diferença de potencial elétrico entre do: Electric potential difference between two points: the "pressure" pushing charges through a circuit.
Fluxo de carga elétrica por unidade de t: Flow of electric charge per unit of time. 1 A = 1 coulomb per second.
Oposição à passagem de corrente que diss: Opposition to current that dissipates energy as heat. It's independent of frequency.
Oposição total à corrente alternada, com: Total opposition to alternating current, combining resistance and reactance; it varies with frequency. For headphones, it's given as a nominal value.
Parte da impedância que armazena e devol: The part of impedance that stores and returns energy (in capacitors and inductors) rather than dissipating it; it depends on frequency.
Impedância interna de uma fonte (amplifi: The internal impedance of a source (amplifier, DAC). It forms a voltage divider with the headphone's impedance and can alter its response.
SPL que um fone produz para uma entrada: The SPL a headphone produces for a reference input: 1 mW (dB/mW) or 1 V RMS (dB/V).
Margem entre o nível de operação típico: The margin between the typical operating level and the maximum level before clipping.
Corte do sinal quando ele excede o limit: Cutting off of the signal when it exceeds a system's limit (supply voltage, 0 dBFS). It generates severe, harmonic-rich distortion.
Conversor digital-analógico: transforma: Digital-to-analog converter: turns numerical samples into a voltage that's continuous in time.
Conversor analógico-digital: mede um sin: Analog-to-digital converter: measures an electrical signal at regular instants and represents it in numbers.
Circuito que usa energia de uma fonte de: A circuit that uses energy from a power supply to produce a larger copy (in voltage, current or both) of an input signal.
Estágio que eleva sinais fracos a nível: A stage that raises weak signals to line level and/or handles volume control and source selection before the power amplifier.
Distorção harmônica total (e com ruído):: Total harmonic distortion (and noise): the energy of harmonics (and noise) added by the system, relative to the signal, in % or dB.
Relação sinal-ruído: diferença entre o n: Signal-to-noise ratio: the difference between the level of a reference signal and the system's noise floor, in dB.
Diferença entre o maior sinal sem distor: The difference between the largest undistorted signal and a system's noise floor.
Ruído de fundo audível, típico de fontes: Audible background noise, typical of noisy sources used with very sensitive headphones.
Dispositivo em que elétrons emitidos por: A device in which electrons emitted by a heated cathode in a vacuum are controlled by a grid. The basis of tube amplifiers.
Em fones, saída em que cada canal é acio: In headphones, an output in which each channel is driven by two amplifiers in opposition, with no common ground. Different from a professional balanced line.
Medição de um sinal contínuo em instante: Measuring a continuous signal at regular instants. The sampling rate (fs) is the number of samples per second.
Metade da taxa de amostragem. Um sinal l: Half the sampling rate. A signal limited to below it can be exactly reconstructed from the samples.
Quando frequências acima de Nyquist são: When frequencies above Nyquist are sampled, they appear "disguised" as lower frequencies that weren't in the signal.
Arredondamento de cada amostra ao valor: Rounding each sample to the nearest value on a finite grid; the resulting error behaves like noise when there's dither.
Número de bits por amostra. Cada bit adi: Number of bits per sample. Each bit adds ~6 dB of dynamic range: 16 bits ≈ 96 dB, 24 bits ≈ 144 dB (theoretical).
Ruído de baixo nível adicionado antes da: Low-level noise added before quantization to decorrelate the error from the signal, turning distortion into constant noise.
Modulação por código de pulso: represent: Pulse-code modulation: representing audio as a sequence of amplitude samples at regular intervals.
Direct Stream Digital: formato de 1 bit: Direct Stream Digital: a 1-bit format with a very high sampling rate (2.8224 MHz on SACD) and noise shifted out of the audible band.

Compressão com perdas: descarta informaç: Compression with loss: discards information a psychoacoustic model considers inaudible (MP3, AAC, Opus, Vorbis).
Quantidade de dados por segundo de áudio: Amount of data per second of audio (kbps). 16-bit/44.1 kHz stereo PCM = 1411 kbps.
Loudness Units relative to Full Scale: m: Loudness Units relative to Full Scale: an integrated loudness measure defined in ITU-R BS.1770, used for normalization.
Pico estimado do sinal analógico reconst: The estimated peak of the reconstructed analog signal, which can exceed the largest sample value (inter-sample peak).
Alteração intencional da resposta em fre: Intentional change to a signal's frequency response using filters.
Equalizador em que frequência, ganho e l: An equalizer in which the frequency, gain and width (Q) of each filter can be continuously adjusted.
Medida da “estreiteza” de um filtro ress: A measure of how "narrow" a resonant filter is: center frequency divided by bandwidth. High Q = narrow filter.
Ganho negativo aplicado antes do equaliz: Negative gain applied before the equalizer to compensate for boosts and avoid digital clipping.
Sistemas em que fase e magnitude estão r: Systems in which phase and magnitude are rigidly linked. Most headphone behavior is approximately minimum phase, which is why EQ also corrects the associated time response.
Processamento que mistura parte de cada: Processing that mixes part of each channel (filtered and delayed) into the other, imitating listening on speakers.
Processador que reduz automaticamente o: A processor that automatically reduces the gain when the signal exceeds a threshold, decreasing dynamic range.
In-ear monitor: fone inserido no canal a: In-ear monitor: an earphone inserted in the ear canal that seals it, isolating the environment and forming a small pressure chamber with the eardrum.
Fechamento hermético do canal auditivo p: The airtight closure of the ear canal by the eartip. Without it, bass leaks away and drops drastically.
Peça de silicone, espuma ou outro materi: A piece of silicone, foam or other material that couples the IEM's nozzle to the ear canal.

O processo de definir a resposta (e o ca: The process of defining a headphone's response (and character) by choosing drivers, filters, tubes, chambers and crossovers.

Precisão com que as fontes são posiciona: The precision with which sources are positioned between (and beyond) the left and right channels.

Tendência a perceber o que se espera per: The tendency to perceive what you expect to perceive, influenced by price, brand, appearance or prior opinions.

Deslocamento do diafragma. Reforços de g: Displacement of the diaphragm. Bass boosts demand more excursion and can push the driver into its nonlinear region.
